c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.1.evidence: Throwaway qa_rft_m1 signs in through the Login block: page updates in place (same URL) to "You are signed in as qa_rft_m1" with My profile / Log out.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.2.evidence: Wrong password and unknown user both show "Incorrect username or password.".

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.3.evidence: Empty submit shows "Enter your username and password.".

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.4.evidence: Guest POST /auth/login with wrong passwords: 401 x3 then 429 jetonomy_rate_limited "Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.".

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.5.evidence: users_can_register=1 and require_email_verification on: registering qa_rft_zq created the account and "Confirm your email to finish signing up" arrived in Mailpit; login then says "Confirm your email to finish signing up".

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.6.evidence: Duplicate email -> "That email is unavailable."; duplicate username -> "That username is unavailable.".

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.7.evidence: 5-char password -> "Password must be at least 8 characters."; mailinator address -> "Please use a permanent email address. Disposable mailboxes are not accepted.".

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.8.evidence: users_can_register=0: POST /auth/register -> 403 jetonomy_registration_disabled "Registration is disabled on this site."; Register tab absent from the block.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.9.evidence: Needs a Cloudflare Turnstile/reCAPTCHA provider (third-party service), none installed on this stack.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.10.evidence: Needs a configured captcha provider that can fail (third-party service), none installed.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.11.evidence: Captcha provider off (default): register/login forms carry no challenge field (only the hidden honeypot) and registration and posting work.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.12.evidence: QA-RFT account with a global_ban restriction logs in through the block: "Your account has been banned from this community. Contact a moderator..."; REST 403 jetonomy_user_banned.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.13.evidence: Reign dark at 390: login title rgb(229,229,229) on dark card, contrast 16.65:1 (screenshot jt207-w3-loginblock-390dark.png).

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.15.evidence: Request aborted: "Network error. Please try again." in role=alert element that takes focus, username and password stay filled, button re-enabled.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.16.evidence: 60-char username registers (accepted); its profile at 390 has no horizontal overflow.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.17.evidence: Register form fields: username, email, password (plus hidden honeypot "website"); no display-name field.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.18.evidence: Five register POSTs in a minute succeed, the next ones return 429.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.19.evidence: Resend confirmation after the cooldown -> "If an account is waiting on confirmation for that email, a new link is on its way." and a second Confirm email arrives.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.20.evidence: On Resend the message becomes the success sentence with class is-success (green), replacing the pending error.

c-anon-quick-login-and-captcha.21.evidence: Second click within 60s -> "A link was just sent. Please wait 58 seconds before asking for another." (REST 429 jetonomy_resend_cooldown). Observation: a first resend seconds after registering answers success without sending a second mail.
